biotools.summary: TRACERx-PHLEX is a Nextflow pipeline that performs deep learning-based cell segmentation, automated cell-type annotation, and spatial analysis of multiplexed imaging data. It provides an end-to-end solution for analyzing highly multiplexed data and generating clinically relevant insights.
